Name: (CP) More Minecarts
Author: Pagofr
Description:
I liked the minecart spots of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2271]Extended Minecarts mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38902465]Entoarox[/url] , but it broke with the 1.6 update, so i made an Content Patcher mod with those minecarts and more.

[u]This mod does not add the refueling of minecarts.[/u]

The minecart spots are:
[list]
[*][b]Farm[/b] (all farmtypes, can be moved in the config)
[*][b]Desert[/b] (near the Skull Cavern) [Unlocked with bus]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Cindersap Forest[/b] (near the Wizard tower)
[*][b]Secret Woods [/b][Unlocked the next day after visiting the secret woods for the first time]
[*][b]Railroad[/b] (near the Bathhouse)
[*][b]Beach[/b]
[*][b]Ginger Island[/b] (on the farm) [Unlocked after getting access to the island farm]
[/list]
Only compatible with SDV 1.6+
Stardew Valley Expanded compatibility is planned.

[b]Found bugs or have questions?
Feel free to make a comment, i will try to answer them quickly.[/b]

Manifest.Name: More Minecarts
Manifest.Description: Adds minecart locations like the ones in Extended Minecarts mod
